key_insight: InterleaveThinker aims to make AI generate text and images in an interleaved sequence, moving beyond single-image output toward richer multimodal storytelling and interaction. It improves open-source unified multimodal models by training them to handle agentic, step-by-step interleaved generation more effectively.
problem_solved: Existing image generators and even unified multimodal models are strong at single-image generation and editing, but struggle to produce coherent text-image sequences. This limits their use in visual narratives, guided creation, and embodied or action-oriented tasks.
method: Introduces an agentic training approach for interleaved generation, where the model learns to alternate between text and image outputs in a coherent sequence.
Reinforces the model to better follow multi-step multimodal instructions and maintain consistency across generated elements.
Targets open-source unified multimodal models to improve their practical performance on interleaved text-image tasks.
impact: This work expands what generative AI can do beyond isolated images, enabling more useful multimodal assistants for storytelling, education, design workflows, and interactive agents. For practitioners, it offers a path toward models that can reason and generate across modalities in a single coherent process.
